paper_method.main_comparison_loss: Data-Balance Loss, Eq.1; within-task supervised-token mean, then equal task mean
paper_method.simple_mixed_interpretation: The paper describes SFT-Mixed as treating combined tasks as one. Under this grouping Eq.1 reduces to a combined token mean; this reformulation is our mathematical explanation.
paper_method.extensions_boundary: Focal and FAMO-inspired balancing appear in section 3.5, but the main comparison specifies Eq.1. Later CoBa code must not be attributed to all original results.

table_2.base_provenance: The table attributes its base numbers to the CodeLlama paper; same-protocol re-evaluation in MFTCoder is not established.

shared_setup_reported: QLoRA trainable parameter locations and initial values
experimental_scope.stopping: Each model independently stopped using its validation-loss criterion.
experimental_scope.sql_evaluation: Text-to-SQL is an unseen-task transfer evaluation, not SQL-plus-Agent mixed training.
experimental_scope.causal_attribution_limit: The reported comparison supports the Eq.1-based training scheme; independent early stopping and unverified total budgets prevent attributing every gain solely to one isolated loss operator.

code_audit.scope: Static inspection of CE reduction and primary caller; not a complete reproduction or distributed-backend run.

files.focus: training loss call, task weight source, per-microbatch backward
collator mask alignment, unused instance weight, args.task_weights
role-dependent loss mask, packing and sequence-row units
2024-10-31 v0.5 release notes distinguish later CoBa from original MFTCoder v1.

case1.unit: all effective tokens in the current call

case2.unit: per-input-row token mean, then mean over input rows

case3.unit: within-task token mean, then task_weights over tasks present in the current call

case4.unit: within-task input-row mean, then task_weights over tasks present in the current call

mask_paths: When loss_mask is absent, labels=-100 are ignored.
When loss_mask is supplied, CE is multiplied by it and denominators use its sums.
The inspected primary collator supplies and aligns loss_mask with next-token labels.
code_audit.instance_weight_limit: The collator reads instance weight but does not return it in result_batch. The trainer passes task_weights; these are separate from sampling-related weights.
code_audit.packing_limit: case2/case4 average tensor rows, not necessarily original data records or trajectories.
code_audit.local_normalization_limit: Only current rank/microbatch tasks enter weights_sum; the loss function does not aggregate denominators across microbatches or ranks before normalization.
code_audit.denominator_assumption: All relevant per-row/per-task denominators are positive.
code_audit.auxiliary_loss_scope: The formulas describe the CE component; some model configurations may add auxiliary losses.
code_audit.focal_scope_limit: The inspected accelerate loss_func_mft has case1/2/3/4/coba branches and no Eq.2/3 focal modulation. This is not an assertion about every historical file in the repository.

teaching_example.origin: Original illustrative arithmetic, not observed business data or a paper experiment.
teaching_example.scope: One local aggregation with both tasks present, no packing or splitting, positive masks.
teaching_example.limit: Objective coefficients do not equal measured gradient norms or task-performance gains.

current_assessment: Core reading completed. Retain task-objective definition, partition sensitivity, and distinct learning-progress signals as references; neither this paper nor DiFT establishes a business solution or the cause of the reported dual regression.

sample_focal.probability: Arithmetic mean of supervised target-token probabilities within a sample; not sequence or task success probability.
sample_focal.loss: Mean token NLL per sample, then alpha_i*(1-Pbar_ij)^gamma weighting and global sample mean.

task_focal.probability: Within-task average of per-sample mean target-token probabilities.
task_focal.loss: Within-task average of per-sample NLL means, then alpha_i*(1-Pbar_i)^gamma and equal task aggregation.
task_focal.gamma_zero_limit: Does not generally reduce to Eq.1 when effective sample lengths differ.

convergence.location: Section 3.5 Eq.4; Section 6; Appendix B Figure 7
convergence.signal: Relative validation-loss improvement under a candidate direction; weighting aims to help the slowest progressing task.
convergence.notation_limit: g_t is defined, but theta_t-alpha*d_t appears without a definition of d_t in the same passage.
convergence.author_reported_limit: The authors report unfavorable cost versus gain in their attempted FAMO-style balancing; not a verified claim that original FAMO inherently requires two model backpropagations.
convergence.figure_7: Convergence curves under data-balanced loss, not an ablation proving Eq.4 benefits.

method_extensions.evidence_limit: Main comparison explicitly uses Eq.1, so main-table deltas do not separately establish focal or convergence-balancing gains.

continuation_teaching_examples.origin: Original mathematical examples, not paper experiments or measured business data.

sparse_critical_position.limit: Low target probability is not a measured deterministic action failure.

validation_progress.formula_scope: Historical finite differences for teaching only; not an implementation of Eq.4.

task_partition.condition: Split SQL into five groups with equal total supervised-token counts; keep Agent as one group.

gradient_direction.scope: Fixed weights, ordinary gradient descent, small-step first-order reasoning; not Adam behavior, business metrics, or an explanation of dual regression below the common start.
